notes: v0.6.10: fix the component-check collector to actually look for the pavucontrol scripts. The v0.6.6 manifest added two new config_files entries (start_pavucontrol.sh, stop_pavucontrol.sh) but the collector script collect-box-status.sh kept its hardcoded file list from v0.6.5. The component check page reports "missing" for any manifest entry the collector doesn't know about, so the pavucontrol scripts showed as missing even after v0.6.9 shipped them to disk. This release adds the two pavucontrol scripts to the collector's hardcoded list and removes /etc/systemd/system/modem73.service (retired in v0.6.6, manifest no longer lists it). After this release, the component check on g90digi will correctly report both pavucontrol scripts as present.
